SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(bs.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON a.account_id = bs.account_id
    AND bs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(AVG(d.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_overdue_days
    FROM delinquency_snapshot d1
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM delinquency_snapshot d2 WHERE d2.loan_id = d1.loan_id)
) d
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
       eg.group_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC, eg.group_name;

SELECT
    isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS npl_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
GROUP BY isec.sector_code, isec.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY npl_ratio DESC, isec.sector_name_zh;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level;

SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
       p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
      AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS record_count,
       ROUND(SUM(dse.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = dse.institution_id
WHERE dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id
WHERE rse.completion_date IS NULL OR rse.completion_date > rse.deadline_date
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT d.loan_id,
       d.principal_overdue_days AS overdue_days,
       cg.grade_name_zh AS classification_name,
       rc.as_of_date AS classification_date
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN (
    SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
    FROM delinquency_snapshot
    GROUP BY loan_id
) dmax ON d.loan_id = dmax.loan_id AND d.as_of_date = dmax.max_date
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
    FROM risk_classification
    GROUP BY loan_id
) rcmax ON rc.loan_id = rcmax.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = rcmax.max_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC, d.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_balance
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
  ON lbs.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_balance DESC;

SELECT pi.instruction_id, pi.loan_id, p.display_name, s.sector_name_zh, pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS restricted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_id, ma.maturity_on, wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       g.guarantor_count,
       b.borrower_count
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT guarantor_party_id, COUNT(*) AS guarantor_count
    FROM guarantor_commitment
    GROUP BY guarantor_party_id
) g ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT borrower_party_id, COUNT(*) AS borrower_count
    FROM credit_agreement
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
) b ON b.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY g.guarantor_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pe.business_date,
       ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
       pe.amount,
       ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ind_reg.sector_name_zh AS registered_industry_name,
       ind_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
       ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind_reg ON ind_reg.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ind_target.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pe.business_date,
       pe.amount,
       payer_holder.party_id AS payer_party_id,
       payee_holder.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account payer_acc ON payer_acc.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder payer_holder ON payer_holder.account_id = payer_acc.account_id
                                AND payer_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account payee_acc ON payee_acc.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN account_holder payee_holder ON payee_holder.account_id = payee_acc.account_id
                                AND payee_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
        AND (
            (pr.source_party_id = payer_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payee_holder.party_id)
            OR
            (pr.source_party_id = payee_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payer_holder.party_id)
        )
  )
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.origin_org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1 AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT sm.staff_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN account acc ON pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
WHERE s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY cnt DESC, sm.staff_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT cdd.record_id,
       i.institution_name,
       cdd.event_date,
       cdd.deadline_date,
       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cdd.institution_id
WHERE cdd.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT cl.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
       ca.status AS 抵押物状态,
       sa.status AS 担保合同状态
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY cl.security_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ca.agreement_id, sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate > avg_rate.avg_rate * 1.1
ORDER BY premium_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS 超限客户数
FROM (
    SELECT ld.agreement_id,
           SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
) lp
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = lp.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = ca.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lp.total_principal > 0.1 * cs.net_capital
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 超限客户数 DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH group_loan AS (
    SELECT eg.exposure_group_id,
           eg.group_name,
           eg.institution_id,
           SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm
      ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca
      ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
     AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld
      ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb
      ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
     AND lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
cap AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT g.exposure_group_id,
       g.group_name,
       ROUND(g.total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
       ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(g.total_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
FROM group_loan g
JOIN cap c ON c.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE g.total_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, ca.maturity_on, ld.loan_id, ld.status, ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ld.disbursement_account_id,
       ld.disbursed_on,
       pe.payment_id,
       pe.business_date,
       ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
       CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_after_disbursement
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY days_after_disbursement ASC, amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
customer_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(llb.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON llb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ce.institution_id,
        ce.borrower_party_id,
        ce.total_principal,
        c.net_capital,
        ROUND(ce.total_principal * 1.0 / c.net_capital, 6) AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ce.institution_id ORDER BY ce.total_principal * 1.0 / c.net_capital DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_exposure ce
    JOIN capital c ON c.institution_id = ce.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    r.ratio
FROM ranked r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.borrower_party_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT lbs.loan_id,
           lbs.principal_balance,
           ca.institution_id,
           NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT loan_id, ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance, quartile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    lbs.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id), 2) AS ratio_pct
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, ratio_pct DESC, lbs.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_total,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, overdue_principal_total DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on, COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_cnt
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_cnt DESC, ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
INTERSECT
SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY party_id;

SELECT sm.person_party_id
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_event pe
      WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
        AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC, security_id;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS maturity_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY CASE maturity_bucket WHEN '常态' THEN 1 WHEN '临期' THEN 2 WHEN '已到期' THEN 3 END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS related_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY related_count DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT ca.collateral_type,
       ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC, ca.collateral_type;

WITH repayment_loan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ld.repayment_account_id AS repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on AS disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount AS disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
account_loan_count AS (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_cnt
    FROM repayment_loan
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT rl.repayment_account_id,
           rl.loan_id,
           rl.disbursed_on,
           rl.disbursed_amount,
           alc.loan_cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rl.repayment_account_id ORDER BY rl.disbursed_on ASC, rl.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM repayment_loan rl
    JOIN account_loan_count alc ON alc.repayment_account_id = rl.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT repayment_account_id,
       loan_id,
       disbursed_on,
       ROUND(disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
       loan_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed,
       ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS drawdown_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT abs.account_id) AS 账户数量,
       ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS 差额合计
FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND abs.available_balance IS NOT NULL
  AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 差额合计 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT td.account_id, td.opening_principal, td.maturity_on, td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 单笔放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 0.9
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
       ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS borrower_party_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS overdue_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status <> 'OVERDUE' OR rs.status IS NULL THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT pi.instruction_id,
       pi.loan_id,
       borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
       payee.display_name AS payee_name,
       ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON borrower.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_on, ca.agreement_id, ca.signed_on, ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS 未结清期次数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_on, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on, ld.loan_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.account_kind, ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id

SELECT ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
       ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
       ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 合同金额,
       p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

WITH related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
    WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
),
inst_product_avg AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, ca.product_family,
           AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
)
SELECT p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
       ca.borrower_party_id AS 客户编号,
       ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS 合同年利率,
       ROUND(ipa.avg_rate, 4) AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
       ROUND(ipa.avg_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS 利率价差
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN related_borrowers rb ON rb.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN inst_product_avg ipa ON ipa.institution_id = ca.institution_id
                          AND ipa.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate < ipa.avg_rate
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC, ca.borrower_party_id;

SELECT pr.source_party_id AS source_party_id,
       pr.target_party_id AS target_party_id,
       rtc.relation_name_zh AS relation_name
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca
              JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
              WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca
              JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
              WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id)
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

SELECT
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
   AND SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account fa ON fa.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder fah ON fah.account_id = fa.account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer.party_id = fah.party_id
JOIN account ta ON ta.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN account_holder tah ON tah.account_id = ta.account_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = tah.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.party_id, payer.display_name, payee.party_id, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC, 付款方姓名, 收款方姓名;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY wp.product_id;

SELECT phs.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT phs.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, phs.product_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    lbs.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
    ON ds.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, lbs.loan_id ASC;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
       eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS 涉及机构数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 取得授信的成员数
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 涉及机构数 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
       eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 逾期成员数,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 对外担保合计,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount) - SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT p.display_name AS employee_name, sm.staff_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY agreement_count DESC, sm.staff_id;

SELECT p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
       p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
       ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 年收入,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
       so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
       so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC, so.operator_id;

SELECT p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
       ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 放款金额,
       ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH borrower_repayment AS (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_due
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
       p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
       ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 个人年收入,
       ROUND(br.total_due, 2) AS 应还本息总额,
       ROUND(br.total_due * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM borrower_repayment br
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = br.party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = br.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL AND pp.annual_income > 0
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
       COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ld.drawdown_type
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_code, lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, lpc.product_name_zh;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id,
       ou.unit_name,
       COUNT(*) AS joint_account_count
FROM account a
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
JOIN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account_holder
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT party_id) >= 2
) mh ON mh.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
       ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 逾期笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT rs.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
       COUNT(*) AS 逾期期数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS 逾期贷款数
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 逾期贷款数 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT loan_id, installment_no, principal_due, interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE' AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC, loan_id, installment_no;

WITH facility_total AS (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(limit_amount) AS total_limit
    FROM credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
disbursed_total AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(net_capital) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ft.total_limit, 0), 2) AS total_limit,
       ROUND(COALESCE(dt.total_disbursed, 0), 2) AS total_disbursed,
       ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(dt.total_disbursed * 1.0 / c.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN disbursed_total dt ON dt.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital c ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN facility_total ft ON ft.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE dt.total_disbursed > c.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS 设定担保金额,
       COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT cf.facility_id, cf.limit_amount, sc.name_zh
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC, cf.facility_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码,
       ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信限额合计
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT cf.facility_type, COUNT(*) AS facility_count
FROM credit_facility cf
WHERE cf.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY cf.facility_type
ORDER BY facility_count DESC, cf.facility_type;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pmc.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           minimum_holding_days,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS grp
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
)
SELECT grp,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
GROUP BY grp
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY grp;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
       COUNT(*) AS pending_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pmc.payment_mode = pi.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY pending_count DESC;

SELECT it.name_zh AS 融资工具中文名称, sc.name_zh AS 状态中文名称
FROM instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY it.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM staff_assignment sa
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       cg.grade_name_zh,
       ds.principal_overdue_days,
       ROUND(ds.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS 覆盖不足借据笔数
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND ps.required_amount > 0
  AND ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY 覆盖不足借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS 拨备缺口合计
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY 拨备缺口合计 DESC, i.institution_name ASC

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, b.ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot b ON b.account_id = a.account_id AND b.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM account_holder h
      WHERE h.account_id = a.account_id AND h.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
  )
ORDER BY b.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
       COUNT(*) AS 客户数量
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 客户分层 ASC;

SELECT ma.asset_category_primary,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN industry_sector ind ON ma.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY cnt DESC, ma.asset_category_primary;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pp.occupation_code,
       pp.employment_sector,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code ASC, pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT pc.status AS card_status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY pc.status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, pc.status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pc.card_id,
       pc.holder_party_id,
       pe.business_date,
       ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
  AND ptc.name_zh IN ('现金存入', '现金支取')
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT pc.holder_party_id AS party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card pc
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, pc.holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON ct.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND ct.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY ct.card_type, ct.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, ct.name_zh;

SELECT pe.channel,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.is_cash = 0
GROUP BY pe.channel
HAVING AVG(pe.amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, pe.channel ASC;

SELECT td.account_id, td.maturity_on, a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id AS 押品编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 押品标识,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS 被引用次数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS 关联担保合同数
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 被引用次数 DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC

WITH loan_total AS (
    SELECT ld.agreement_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
)
SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(lt.total_disbursed, 2) AS 实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN loan_total lt ON lt.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.guaranteed_amount > lt.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 授信合同金额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS 担保覆盖合计,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS 保障缺口
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN security_agreement sa
    ON sa.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) < ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, ca.agreement_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS 拨备不足借据笔数
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 拨备不足借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name ASC

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 贷款余额,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ca.contract_amount > 0
  AND lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC

WITH latest_provision AS (
    SELECT loan_id, required_amount, recognized_amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, provision_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM provision_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date <= '2026-06-30'
),
latest_classification AS (
    SELECT loan_id, grade_code,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, classification_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM risk_classification
    WHERE as_of_date <= '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       cg.grade_name_zh,
       COUNT(*) AS 多计提笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(lp.recognized_amount - lp.required_amount), 2) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM latest_provision lp
JOIN latest_classification lc ON lc.loan_id = lp.loan_id AND lc.rn = 1
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = lc.grade_code AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lp.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lp.rn = 1
  AND lp.recognized_amount > lp.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC

WITH internal_val AS (
  SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal
  FROM collateral_valuation
  WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
  GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_val AS (
  SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external
  FROM collateral_valuation
  WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
  GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT ca.collateral_id,
       ca.asset_label,
       ROUND(iv.max_internal, 2) AS max_internal,
       ROUND(ev.max_external, 2) AS max_external,
       ROUND(iv.max_internal - ev.max_external, 2) AS undervalue_diff
FROM internal_val iv
JOIN external_val ev ON ev.collateral_id = iv.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = iv.collateral_id
WHERE ev.max_external < iv.max_internal
ORDER BY undervalue_diff DESC, ca.collateral_id;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT cv.collateral_id, cv.valuation_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    JOIN (
        SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
        FROM collateral_valuation
        GROUP BY collateral_id
    ) lv ON lv.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id AND lv.max_valued_on = cv.valued_on
),
pledged AS (
    SELECT cl.collateral_id, SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
)
SELECT ca.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号,
       ca.asset_label AS 资产名称,
       ROUND(lv.valuation_amount, 2) AS 最新评估价,
       ROUND(p.total_pledged, 2) AS 累计质押额,
       ROUND(p.total_pledged - lv.valuation_amount, 2) AS 覆盖缺口
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON lv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN pledged p ON p.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE p.total_pledged > lv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 覆盖缺口 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(borrow.borrow_amount, 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(guar.guarantee_amount, 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS borrow_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) borrow ON borrow.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) guar ON guar.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE guar.guarantee_amount > borrow.borrow_amount
ORDER BY guar.guarantee_amount DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT sa.security_id,
       ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
       COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT p.customer_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       c.name_zh AS group_type_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group g
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = g.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog c ON c.group_type = g.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member m ON m.exposure_group_id = g.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, c.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT egm.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 成员客户编号 ASC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 主体编号,
       p.display_name AS 主体名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id AS 关系编号,
    pr.source_party_id AS 关系一方主体编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 关系另一方主体编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) AS 一主体现有借款合同数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id) AS 另一主体现有借款合同数
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN credit_agreement ca_s
    ON ca_s.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
   AND ca_s.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN credit_agreement ca_t
    ON ca_t.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
   AND ca_t.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id)) DESC, pr.relation_id;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, ca.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset ca
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
      AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY ca.collateral_id ASC

WITH guarantor_commit AS (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
own_loan AS (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_loan
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
       p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
       ROUND(gc.total_guaranteed, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ol.total_loan, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
       ROUND(gc.total_guaranteed - COALESCE(ol.total_loan, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_commit gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.party_id
LEFT JOIN own_loan ol ON ol.party_id = gc.party_id
WHERE gc.total_guaranteed > COALESCE(ol.total_loan, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status AS commitment_status
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
      AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
)
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC

SELECT
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ma.asset_name AS 底层资产名称,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS 最终债务人编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND lb.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY 产品名称 ASC, 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT sa.security_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS security_count,
       ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY SUM(so.covered_amount) DESC, sa.security_type;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'RELATED_CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    wp.product_id AS 产品编号,
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS 倒挂金额合计,
    COUNT(*) AS 倒挂持仓笔数
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.fair_value IS NOT NULL
  AND phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, 产品编号 ASC;

SELECT wp.product_name,
       ma.asset_name,
       phs.lookthrough_depth,
       ROUND(phs.carrying_amount, 2) AS carrying_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
      AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
)
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY phs.holding_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS 第一顺位有效记录数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 超过百分之六十的记录数
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 超过百分之六十的记录数 DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, f.total_assets, f.total_liabilities, f.net_assets, f.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY f.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(f.total_liabilities * 1.0 / f.total_assets, 4) AS debt_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY debt_ratio DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets <> 0
ORDER BY tier1_capital_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / f.total_assets, 6) AS ratio_val
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio_val DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(f.annual_revenue, 2) AS 营业收入,
       ROUND(f.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot), 2) AS 占比
FROM financial_snapshot f
JOIN institution i ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE f.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot) > 0.15
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ma.valuation_method,
       ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC, ma.valuation_method;

SELECT i.institution_name AS institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS account_count,
       ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT so.authority_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH under_provision AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
           ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS shortfall_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
net_assets AS (
    SELECT fs.party_id AS party_id,
           fs.net_assets AS net_assets
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT i.institution_id,
       i.institution_name,
       up.shortfall_amount,
       ROUND(na.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
       ROUND(up.shortfall_amount * 1.0 / na.net_assets * 100, 2) AS shortfall_ratio_pct
FROM under_provision up
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = up.institution_id
JOIN net_assets na ON na.party_id = 'PTY-' || up.institution_id
WHERE up.shortfall_amount > 0
ORDER BY shortfall_ratio_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

WITH npl AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS npl_count,
           ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS overdue_total
    FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
rev AS (
    SELECT fs.party_id AS party_id,
           ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue), 2) AS annual_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY fs.party_id
)
SELECT n.institution_id,
       n.npl_count,
       n.overdue_total
FROM npl n
JOIN rev r ON r.party_id = 'PTY-' || n.institution_id
WHERE n.overdue_total * 1.0 / r.annual_revenue > 0.5
ORDER BY n.overdue_total DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS 风险加权资产,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = ca.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT pi.payment_mode,
       COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC, pi.payment_mode;

WITH abnormal AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS abnormal_cnt,
           SUM(amount_value) AS abnormal_amount
    FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3
    WHERE exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
),
cap AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
fin AS (
    SELECT party_id, total_assets
    FROM financial_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       a.abnormal_cnt,
       ROUND(a.abnormal_amount, 2) AS abnormal_amount,
       ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(f.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
       ROUND(a.abnormal_amount * 1.0 / c.net_capital * 100, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM abnormal a
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN cap c ON c.institution_id = a.institution_id
LEFT JOIN fin f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || a.institution_id
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH provision_shortfall AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS shortfall_loan_cnt,
           ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS shortfall_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
reg_overdue AS (
    SELECT r.institution_id AS institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS overdue_cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(r.amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
    WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       ro.overdue_cnt,
       ro.avg_amount,
       COALESCE(psf.shortfall_loan_cnt, 0) AS shortfall_loan_cnt,
       COALESCE(psf.shortfall_amount, 0) AS shortfall_amount
FROM reg_overdue ro
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ro.institution_id
LEFT JOIN provision_shortfall psf ON psf.institution_id = ro.institution_id
WHERE ro.overdue_cnt >= 25
ORDER BY shortfall_amount DESC;

WITH facility_stat AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS facility_cnt
    FROM credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
gov_stat AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS gov_records,
           SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END) AS except_amount,
           AVG(ratio_value) AS avg_ratio
    FROM governance_control_record_v3
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       f.facility_cnt,
       ROUND(g.except_amount, 2) AS except_amount,
       ROUND(g.avg_ratio, 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM gov_stat g
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = g.institution_id
JOIN facility_stat f ON f.institution_id = g.institution_id
ORDER BY except_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_cnt,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN rt.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方' THEN 1 END) AS non_nonrelated_cnt
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 r
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON rt.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY target_party_cnt DESC, relation_type_cnt DESC, p.display_name;

WITH card_stat AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id AS institution_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS card_cnt,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS holder_cnt
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
op_risk AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS valid_cnt,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS except_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.card_cnt,
       cs.holder_cnt,
       o.except_amount,
       o.valid_cnt
FROM op_risk o
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = o.institution_id
JOIN card_stat cs ON cs.institution_id = o.institution_id
WHERE o.valid_cnt >= 43
ORDER BY o.except_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH product_stat AS (
    SELECT issuer_institution_id AS institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS on_sale_cnt,
           ROUND(SUM(actual_raise_amount), 2) AS raise_total
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
    GROUP BY issuer_institution_id
),
conduct_stat AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS record_cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
    FROM product_conduct_event_v3
    WHERE exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       ps.on_sale_cnt,
       ps.raise_total,
       cs.record_cnt,
       cs.avg_ratio
FROM conduct_stat cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN product_stat ps ON ps.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY ps.raise_total DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH asset_stat AS (
    SELECT originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS asset_count,
           ROUND(SUM(issued_amount), 2) AS issued_total
    FROM managed_asset
    GROUP BY originator_institution_id
),
custody_stat AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS valid_cnt,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception_cnt
    FROM custody_operation_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       a.asset_count,
       a.issued_total,
       c.valid_cnt,
       c.exception_amount
FROM asset_stat a
JOIN custody_stat c ON c.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE c.exception_cnt >= 2
ORDER BY a.issued_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
